sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Why today of all days? My alarm worked! I know it did!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and incredulous, half-panicking at the unfairness of being late while desperately insisting she did everything right.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s suddenly panicked and flustered, with a sharp spike of anxiety as she realizes her missing pass could make her already disastrous morning even worse.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on, don't do this to me!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is panicked and increasingly desperate, trying to force herself into control while feeling the morning spiral out of her hands.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously... I stopped to read that creepy note, and now my pass is gone?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and exasperated, with a sharp spike of suspicion and self-reproach as she realizes her own curiosity may have caused the mess.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: I'm late, I'm cardless, and I'm trying very hard not to become a tragedy in a school uniform.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and panicking, but trying to keep her fear under control by turning it into a joking, self-aware complaint.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of disbelief and wary hope, as if the creepy note may actually be leading somewhere real and she’s bracing herself for whatever comes next.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is breathless and panicked but also energized by the urgency, trying to stay upbeat and socially smooth while rushing to fix the disaster.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sudden, breathless relief and grateful excitement, with a lingering edge of disbelief after the morning’s panic.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and instantly wary, her earlier panic sharpening into tense suspicion as she tries to figure out how this stranger knows so much about her.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. That's not a normal sentence.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and wary, trying to mask her unease with a quick, incredulous joke while her mind races to figure out who this person is and what they want.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Did my friends put you up to this? Because this prank is way too elaborate for eight in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled but trying to regain control by turning the situation into a joke, with suspicion and nervous excitement bubbling under her frustration.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: That made it worse. You know that, right?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of alarm and irritated disbelief, with her usual boldness turning into wary suspicion as the stranger’s cryptic warning makes the situation feel even more unsettling.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted into alarmed disbelief, trying to reject the impossible situation out loud while her confidence gives way to a tense, wary panic.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: People do not just vanish before homeroom!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and increasingly alarmed, trying to force a rational explanation onto something that feels impossible while her usual boldness turns into frantic disbelief.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Aah— school! Mystery later, attendance first!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, upbeat determination to stay in control, pushing fear and confusion aside with a nervous, energetic resolve to make it to school on time.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Seat by the window, huh... If that's true, who were you?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s rattled but intensely curious, trying to turn her fear into a determined, investigative focus as she wonders who the stranger really was.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

gpt.rationale: Aoi’s expressive, talkative panic mostly fits an extrovert, but the sprites lean too heavily on fear—missing clearer frustration/comic exasperation on lines like the alarm complaint, the prank accusation, and the final curious reflection.

claude.rationale: An extroverted character who 'laughs openly' and 'speaks her mind readily' should show visible frustration, wide-eyed surprise, and bright grins—yet fear dominates 11 of 15 sprites, with only two surprise and one happiness choice; the sprite sequence flattens her expressiveness into sustained panic rather than the dynamic mood shifts her personality demands.
